readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, the master had everyone show their watches (start of dinner).
The hall clock downstairs struck ten.
When the hall clock struck ten, the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten.
When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
When the master sent Lina downstairs.
When Madame's piano began, Rosa's clock showed two minutes to eleven.
When the piano stopped, Rosa's clock showed eleven minutes past eleven.
The temple struck eleven, after which Lina was still in the kitchen with Rosa.

whereabouts: Lina was at the dinner when the master had everyone show their watches at nine.
After dinner Lina went up to the atelier and worked beside the master.
The master sent Lina downstairs when the regulator showed 10:20.
Lina went straight down to the kitchen.
That afternoon the master was in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands.
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa while Madame's piano played and until after the temple struck eleven.
